Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 197654 Act Number: 54 Enactment Date: 1976-08-18 Act Year: 1976 Short Title: The Telangana State Handloom Weavers Co-operative Society (Formation) Act, 1976. Long Title: An Act to provide for the formation of Telangana State Handloom Weavers Co-operative Society Limited, by amalgamation of the Andhra Handloom Weavers Co-operative Society Limited, the Hyderabad Handloom Weavers Central Co-operative Association Limited, and the Rayalaseema Apex Weavers Co-operative Society Limited and for matters connected therewith and incidental thereto.
